# deepseek-china-search

> Agent execution index. Search public Chinese-web sources through the caller-configured DeepSeek Search API.

Read SKILL.md before use. Apply the caller's actual request and authorization; do not infer permissions from repository examples.

## Required context

- Inputs: the current task, permitted scope, and required source/destination paths or time window.
- Environment: Python 3.10+ and a caller-supplied API key. Search may incur charges; fetching supplied links is not implicit search authorization.
- Read only references needed by the selected mode. Resolve placeholders against the caller environment.
- Preserve input evidence; distinguish observed facts, inferred information and unverified outcomes.
- Verify actual saved output and the selected mode's completion criteria. A ready command, generated draft or successful process is not proof of business completion.

## Authoritative entry

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-deepseek-china-search/main/SKILL.md): capability, activation, mode-specific workflow and boundaries.

## Execution references

- [scripts/deepseek_search.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-deepseek-china-search/main/scripts/deepseek_search.py): Use status to inspect configuration without printing a key; use search only for an authorized search request.
- [references/api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingyun7842/xignyun-deepseek-china-search/main/references/api.md): Read the search contract, supported fields and bounded error behavior.
